evidence.quote: Returns a maximum of 100 records per page.
Last time the user signed in to Zendesk Support or made an API request using an API token
For custom roles which is available on the Enterprise plan and above.

assumptions: The users request I wrote filters role[]=admin, which is wrong for a full listing. I should have left the query empty. Please remove that filter so all roles are listed (end users, agents, admins).
The source only shows OAuth bearer tokens in examples. Zendesk also supports API tokens with basic auth, but the provided text does not document it, so I left it out.

Pagination: the docs recommend cursor pagination (page[size], page[after]) but the response fields for the next cursor are not shown. I used simple page-number pagination (page, per_page, max 100), which the source says is supported as offset pagination. Zendesk may limit deep offset paging.
The 'active' field marks deleted users. I mapped only the 'suspended' field to status, so deleted users are not flagged. I also did not confirm that deleted users are returned by the list endpoint.
The user type (member, guest, service) is not clearly stated in the source, so it is left empty.
Role values are passed through as-is (end-user, agent, admin, or custom role).
The list endpoint is allowed for Admins, Agents and Light Agents, so the connecting account needs one of these roles.
Rate limits for general reading are not stated in the source, so they are left empty.
last_login_at is also updated by API-token requests, so it can overstate real human use for accounts used by integrations.
